task: invisible host writes: pgw funnel, read watch, non-fatal page guard
summary: 97 host-write sites (81 memcpy/memset(vm::ptr), 16 scalar, 1 guest-to-guest memmove) now route through one funnel, runtime/include/runtime/pgwrite.h: pgw::write/fill/copy each call vm::host_write (so a host store is reported, since it cannot fault), open/close a guarded page around the store, then rsv::store_range (which bumps the 128-byte line version, wakes sleepers and feeds block/code/line watch).
